body:
_Migrated from issue #871, filed 2026-07-13._

Smart (magic) shelves can be duplicated in the new UI (the "Duplicate" action in the smart-shelf view), but ordinary shelves can't. Part of the shelf-parity umbrella #867.

Unlike the Kobo-sync gap, this one needs a small backend route — smart shelves have `/magicshelf/<id>/duplicate` (`cps/web.py:1738`), ordinary shelves have no equivalent. Fix:

- Add a `/shelf/<int:shelf_id>/duplicate` POST route that copies the `Shelf` row and its `BookShelf` membership under the current user, named "<name> (copy)" and private by default, honouring the same ownership/permission checks the magic-shelf duplicate uses.
- Add a `useDuplicateShelf` mutation in `frontend/src/lib/queries.ts` (mirror `useDuplicateMagicShelf`, `queries.ts:868`).
- Add a "Duplicate" button to the manage row in `frontend/src/pages/Shelf.tsx` (alongside Rename / Kobo sync / Reorder / Delete), mirroring `MagicShelfView.tsx:76`.

Credit: @auspex (#867).
title: New UI: Duplicate action for ordinary shelves (parity with smart shelves)
